digest.component_or_area: Plan review criterion routing and Pass-1 container analysis
propositions: Plan review certifies epics with mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across parent and children, surfacing contradictions only mid-implementation or at completion-verification rather than during review.

A new 1-TURN criterion ac-satisfiability (facet coherence, advisory default) owns the coherence concern of whether a ticket's own AC and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable, detecting three contradiction patterns: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality.

G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because its sibling roster carries only child ids and titles, preventing it from testing whether siblings cover parent acceptance criteria; the roster must include each child's parsed ac_items.

The sibling roster is built by three independent code copies in pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, and eval_solver.py; consolidating them into a single shared build_sibling_roster helper ensures all callers send consistent rosters and prevents divergence in dogfooding data for G3's deferred posture decision.

The container pass must move the sibling roster from per-pairing instructions into the byte-stable system-prompt prefix to make it cacheable and avoid quadratic re-sending; the roster's token cost must be included in the parent_tokens prefix estimate feeding bin-packing and the warm gate.
